D_shell_in: Shell inner diameter, Chapter 3 (existing furnace configuration)
D_hearth: Hearth diameter inside the lining, Chapter 3
t_lining: (13.70 - 10.88)/2: lining and ramming between shell and hearth
t_floor: Floor lining taken equal to the wall lining
H_cavity: Inside height from hearth floor to roof underside (overall height 9.5 m from the picture)
z_metal: Top of the metal pad above the hearth floor
z_bath: Top of the slag layer above the hearth floor
z_stock: Burden stock line above the hearth floor
z_tip: Electrode tip height above the hearth floor (immersed in the slag layer)
D_plate: Electrode support plate diameter, 0.70 of the shell diameter
h_stub: Stub height between roof top and support plate
offset: Horizontal offset of each vertical electrode tube from its stub (outward)
L_tube: Vertical electrode tube length above the support plate
wall_e: Electrode tube wall thickness (hollow casing in the picture)
L_tap: Tap pipe projection beyond the shell
z_tap: Tap pipe axis height above the hearth floor
tap_angles: Tap pipe azimuths in plan (x to the right, y to the back)
